blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is pushing for a review of the southwestern Black Sea’s maritime risk classification following a series of attacks on commercial vessels, including one that left two Filipino seafarers injured. DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said on Thursday that the department wanted international maritime stakeholders to assess whether the area should be designated a high-risk or warlike zone. “Unfortunately, the areas where ships are being attacked are expanding. These waters used to be safe,” Cacdac said in English in an interview with GMA News’ Unang Balita. Cacdac said the DMW was raising the […]...
